name: AAS Job Register

name: EURAXESS
notes: Separate vacancies, funding calls and hosting offers. Researcher R1–R4 labels describe career stages, not Carnegie institution designations.

name: Physical Society of Japan
notes: Search Japanese-language advertisements as well as English listings.

name: LISA Consortium positions
notes: An observed announcement linking to the positions index; index discovery remains to do.

name: Einstein Telescope Germany opportunities
notes: Includes postdocs and technical jobs; faculty and equivalent roles require screening.

name: ALICE public job announcements
notes: Observed newsletter links to job announcements. Follow to employer notices; do not assume expired historical newsletter entries are open.

name: Spanish State Research Agency: Ramón y Cajal
notes: Official national stage; institute endorsement stages have separate deadlines.

name: Carnegie institution classifications
notes: Official 2025 research designations; campus-specific, not HEP group quality. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 source metadata retained.
